newsitem.title: NORWAY: Gas leak at Norzink plant but zinc output normal.
newsitem.headline: Gas leak at Norzink plant but zinc output normal.

text.p: A leak of sulphurous gas on Wednesday at Norzink's zinc plant at Odda in southwest Norway did not affect production, a company spokesman said.
The gas leak at a sulphuric acid unit was detected early on Wednesday, said Knut Terje Solstad.

"We have stopped operations at that part of the plant to investigate the leak and repair the damage to a ventilation system. But it will only be for a few hours. Production of zinc is normal," Solstad said.
Norzink expects to produce 140,000 tonnes at Odda in 1996. The company is jointly owned by RTZ Corp Plc and Trelleborg AB.
